messages:
Maya (support): Hey @Sam — we got your ticket about tenant metrics being 2–3 hours late in the Console. Can you confirm affected tenant IDs?
Sam (customer): Hi Maya — tenant acme-inc and a couple of our test tenants. Dashboards show gaps starting ~09:10 UTC, spikes in ingestion latency.
Maya (support): Thanks. Repro steps you gave: generate traffic -> check Console hourly view -> missing hours, right?
Sam (customer): Yep. Also some API requests for usage return 502s intermittently around the same time.
Maya (support): Looping in @Luca from infra and @Jin oncall. Backfill plan might be needed if ETL dropped windows.
Luca (eng): Looking at metrics pipeline dashboards now. I see consumer lag on cdc-consumer-3 around 09:00–10:30 UTC, followed by a flurry of retries.
Luca (eng): Consumer logs show repeated auth failures: "401 Unauthorized: token expired" from the connector to the CDC stream.
Jin (eng-oncall): That would explain dropped messages. Was there an auth rotation scheduled?
Maya (support): Sam, did you rotate any KMS keys or service account tokens around that time?
Sam (customer): We rotated a service account credential at 08:55 UTC as part of a scheduled rotation. We thought it was seamless.
Luca (eng): OK that matches. Connector didn't pick up the new token fast enough; cdc-consumer-3 throttled/restarted and missed ~2 hours of events. We see a checkpoint gap at 09:06 UTC.
BackfillBot: Backfill job queued: backfill-job-3742001 for tenant acme-inc, window 2024-03-04T09:00Z -> 2024-03-04T11:00Z.
Jin (eng-oncall): Immediate mitigations: (1) Restart cdc-consumer pods to pick up rotated creds. (2) Increase replicas to drain backlog. (3) Kick manual backfill for affected windows.
K8sBot: Triggered rollout restart of deployment/cdc-consumer-3 at commit sha: abc123. Pods will restart in parallel.
Luca (eng): Restart done. Consumers rebalanced, lag dropping from 120k -> 2k in ~6m.
Maya (support): Running backfill job now, ETA ~18m for the two-hour window. I'll post updates.
Sam (customer): Appreciate the quick response. Can you add a postmortem note about credential rotation causing consumer outages? We need to avoid this for future rotations.
Luca (eng): Agreed — action items: add token hot-swap handling to connector, emit an alert on auth error spikes, and add a checklist for rotations. I'll open a ticket.
Maya (support): BackfillBot reports 60% done, applying events and rehydrating rollups.
BackfillBot: Backfill job complete: success. Reapplied 1,240 events. Console hourly views updated for acme-inc.
Maya (support): Sam, can you confirm your dashboard now?
Sam (customer): Confirmed — hours are backfilled, charts normal. No more 502s. Thanks everyone :clap: 
Jin (eng-oncall): I'll follow up with a short postmortem and link the backfill job id.
Luca (eng): Ticket created: INFRA-4621 "Connector token hot-swap + auth-error alert".
Maya (support): Marking ticket resolved for now. Reopen if anything else crops up.
Sam (customer): All good on our end. Closing the loop.
Maya (support): Closing thread — summary: service-account rotation caused consumer auth failures -> consumer restart + scaled replicas -> manual backfill completed -> dashboards fixed. Action items assigned to infra.
